session.note: Wall-clock build time from the OpenCode session start through local verification, documentation and release. Captured just before the final state commit; use the timestamps as the source of truth. Not an estimate of model-only time.

usage.note: Read from the OpenCode session database (session_v2) with scripts/capture-state.mjs. totalTokens is the sum of all five counters, including prompt context read repeatedly from cache; cache reads dominate the figure. costUSD is 0 on the flat-rate plan.

verification.method: Node built-in test runner for static invariants; a dependency-free headless Chrome harness over the DevTools Protocol for the real UI; a 29-check in-page suite for the deployed copy. Chrome uses --use-mock-keychain and a throwaway profile so macOS does not prompt repeatedly.
checks: 47/47 local headless Chrome checks: boot, WebGL, placement, warnings, swaps, search, curve, persistence, theme, mobile, accessibility
29/29 in-page self-test checks, including data integrity, storage round trip and live WebGL
0 console errors and uncaught exceptions in the local suite
